scientific_integrity: Originality is relative to inspected primary literature and retrieved research records, not a guarantee of historical uniqueness. Exact root-split proof and independent exhaustive small-size checks are provided. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform insertion permutations only; no general stochastic-order property; the 7-key CDF crossing is an exact finite counterexample and does not classify all sizes.
title: Exact negative leaf–path covariance and an obstruction to stochastic ordering in random binary search trees
